sources.generation_prompt: Create one original square 1024x1024 educational Earth-observation demo illustration. A clearly stylized painted cutaway landscape: cobalt ocean, emerald islands with an angular mountain, pale clouds, curved atmospheric bands, a tiny generic abstract observation satellite high above. Editorial science illustration with geometric shapes, elegant restrained teal/blue palette on a dark navy background. Large central island region for a selectable rectangular annotation. Clearly invented geography, not a realistic satellite photograph or a real mapped location. No text, labels, logos, flags, watermark, agency identifiers, recognizable people, copyrighted characters, or imitation of a particular artist. Do not reference or reproduce NASA Blue Marble imagery. This is a fresh illustration to demonstrate selecting regions in a software app.
